questions.prompt: Which statement best describes the purpose of “Integrating Backend Services”?
options: Integrating Backend Services means the browser can enforce all permissions without the backend.
Integrating Backend Services removes the need for error handling, accessibility checks and tests.
Integrating Backend Services should be implemented by copying a snippet without checking the Angular version.
Integrating Backend Services helps explain and implement one part of an Angular application; choose the API pattern that matches the behavior and verify it.
questions.answer_key: Integrating Backend Services helps explain and implement one part of an Angular application; choose the API pattern that matches the behavior and verify it.
questions.explanation: Integrating Backend Services is a concept in the supplied Angular curriculum. Its correct application depends on the intended behavior, surrounding context and verification.

questions.prompt: How should a learner work with “Typed API models” in this lesson?
options: Assume “Typed API models” works identically across every Angular major and runtime.
Use “Typed API models” to bypass runtime validation of external or user-provided values.
Connect “Typed API models” to the lesson goal, use a focused example, and validate the behavior in the selected Angular environment.
Treat “Typed API models” as a reason to skip the surrounding application context.
questions.answer_key: Connect “Typed API models” to the lesson goal, use a focused example, and validate the behavior in the selected Angular environment.
questions.explanation: The PDF explicitly lists “Typed API models” under Integrating Backend Services. Anchor it in a small example and check the behavior rather than relying on a memorized phrase.

questions.prompt: What is the strongest verification approach for “Integrating Backend Services”?
options: Ignore a failing test if the component looks correct in one browser.
Run the example in a compatible local Angular workspace, test the expected result and one failure case, and document any version limitation.
Assume an SVG diagram proves the code compiled and passed tests.
Treat a successful client-side render as backend authorization evidence.
questions.answer_key: Run the example in a compatible local Angular workspace, test the expected result and one failure case, and document any version limitation.
questions.explanation: Verification evidence should match the running environment. Static teaching snippets are not compiler output, and frontend checks do not replace backend authorization.
